text:
This looks like a square plate about 26 cm across, so I'm treating it as a dinner plate. I estimated each item by eye and added them up.

| Item | Mass (g) | Energy (kcal) |
|---|---|---|
| Diced chicken breast | 100 | 165 |
| Pineapple chunks (about 5) | 90 | 45 |
| Broccoli | 80 | 30 |
| Cherry tomatoes (about 5) | 60 | 12 |
| Olives (about 5) | 20 | 30 |
| Fish fillet with topping | 70 | 140 |
| **Total** | **420** | **422** |

Adding a little for the oil on the fish and the olives, I'm rounding the total to about 430 kcal.
